query_text: Plan a seven-day trip in China.

messages.content: Plan a seven-day trip in China.

message.content:
A good **seven-day trip in China** is to focus on **2–3 cities**, not the whole country, so you spend more time sightseeing and less time in transit.[4][5] The most common first-timer routes are **Beijing–Xi’an–Shanghai**, **Beijing–Shanghai**, or a **single-region trip** such as Yunnan, Sichuan, or Zhangjiajie.[2][4][5]

## Recommended 7-day itinerary: Beijing, Xi’an, Shanghai

- **Day 1: Beijing** — Arrive, settle in, and take a light evening walk through **Wangfujing** or nearby hutongs.[1][5]
- **Day 2: Beijing** — Visit the **Forbidden City**, **Tiananmen Square**, and **Temple of Heaven**.[2][3][5]
- **Day 3: Beijing** — Spend the day at the **Great Wall**; Mutianyu is a common choice for a cable-car or hike experience.[1][3][5]
- **Day 4: Xi’an** — Travel to Xi’an and see the **Terracotta Army**.[2][3][5]
- **Day 5: Xi’an to Shanghai** — Explore the **Xi’an City Wall**, **Muslim Quarter**, or **Shaanxi History Museum**, then fly or take a train to Shanghai.[2][3][5]
- **Day 6: Shanghai** — Visit **The Bund**, **Yu Garden**, and the surrounding old market area.[2][3][5]
- **Day 7: Shanghai** — Add a final museum, skyline stop, or relaxed shopping time before departure.[2][5]

## If you want a simpler 7-day plan

- **Beijing + Shanghai** works well if you want fewer transfers and a mix of imperial history plus modern city life.[4]
- **Beijing + Xi’an** is best if your priority is history and ancient China.[4][5]
- **Yunnan or Sichuan** is better if you prefer one region with nature, food, and a slower pace.[4][6]

## Practical planning notes

- Use **high-speed trains** for shorter intercity legs and **flights** when crossing longer distances, especially Xi’an to Shanghai.[2][5]
- A 7-day trip is most comfortable when you keep it to **two cities** or a **single region**, because that leaves room for real sightseeing instead of constant travel.[4][5]
- If it is your first time in China, **Beijing, Xi’an, and Shanghai** is the most commonly recommended “classic” route.[2][5]

If you want, I can turn this into a **budget trip**, a **luxury trip**, or a **family-friendly 7-day China itinerary**.
